title: 第21章 如临大敌的归元宗第22章 赤血魔蝎
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
“不知前辈怎么称呼？您去归元宗，又有何贵干呢？”
鹤老走上前来，对罗天问道。
罗天将口中食物咽下，然后道：“我叫罗天，去归元宗是为了紫微秘境的事情。
另外，别叫我前辈，我今年才十八岁而已。”
说着，继续干肉。
然而听了他这句话，在场几人全都愣住了。
尤其是杜邵元。
“十八？他十八岁？比我还小几岁？开玩笑的吧？”
杜邵元感觉自己的世界观似乎都要崩塌了。
一个十八岁的年轻人，实力会强到撞死通玄境？
鹤老同样一脸的难以置信。
“前……啊不，罗公子，您是认真的？”
罗天白了他一眼，道：“骗你我有什么好处么？”
鹤老一愣，然后默默点了点头。
是啊，罗天的确没有骗他的必要。
但这样一来，他就更震惊了。
一个十八岁的少年，实力却远胜自己。
这意味着什么？
“罗公子，您应该是中州某个势力的圣子吧？”
鹤老想到了某种可能，开口询问道。

传说之中，中州的几大圣地，拥有着难以想象的实力。
这种地方，用万年的传承，和海量的资源，堆出一些强悍的妖孽，也是有可能的。
然而，罗天继续一边吃烤肉一边说道：“不是，我就是夜风国边北城人。”
“什么？你是夜风国人？”
鹤老再次震惊了。
他猛的转过头，看向了少女。
少女此刻也是一脸愕然。
显然他们都没有想到罗天的身份竟然是这样。
“罗公子，您现在是什么修为？”
少女也顾不得手里的小五月了，一脸严肃的问罗天。
“我？炼体境九重。”
罗天如实回答。
“这……我懂了，是我冒昧了，您不想说也在情理之中。”
少女点点头。
在她看来，罗天显然是没有说实话。
炼体境的修为，能有这种水准？
骗谁呢？
罗天见状，也明白了对方的心情。
但他也懒得解释。
content_en:
"I don't know what I call you, senior? What's the point of going to Guiyuan Sect?"
Mr. He stepped forward and asked Luo Tian.
Luo Tian swallowed the food in his mouth, and then said: "My name is Luo Tian, and I went to Guiyuan Sect for the purpose of Ziwei Secret Realm.
Also, don’t call me senior, I’m only eighteen years old. "
Saying that, he continued to dry the meat.
However, after hearing his words, everyone present was stunned.
Especially Du Shaoyuan.
"Eighteen? He's eighteen? How much younger than me? Are you kidding me?"
Du Shaoyuan felt as if his world view was about to collapse.
Would an eighteen-year-old young man be so strong that he could kill Tongxuan Realm?
Mr. He also looked in disbelief.
"Ex... ah no, Mr. Luo, are you serious?"
Luo Tian rolled his eyes at him and said, "What's the benefit of lying to you and me?"
He Lao was stunned for a moment, then nodded silently.
Yes, there was indeed no need for Luo Tian to lie to him.
But this way, he was even more shocked.
An eighteen-year-old boy, but his strength is far superior to his own.
what does that mean?
"Master Luo, you should be the holy son of a certain force in Zhongzhou, right?"
He Lao thought of some possibility and asked.
According to legend, several holy places in Zhongzhou possess unimaginable strength.
In a place like this, with thousands of years of inheritance and massive resources, it is possible to create some powerful monsters.
However, Luo Tian continued to eat barbecue and said, "No, I am from Beicheng on the border of Night Breeze Kingdom."
"What? Are you from the Night Wind Country?"
Mr. He was shocked again.
He turned his head sharply and looked at the girl.
The girl also looked stunned at this moment.
Obviously, none of them expected Luo Tian's identity to be like this.
"Master Luo, what is your current level of cultivation?"
The girl didn't care about the little May in her hand and asked Luo Tian seriously.
"Me? I am at the ninth level of the body refining realm."
Luo Tian answered truthfully.
"This... I understand. I was presumptuous. It's understandable that you don't want to say it."
The girl nodded.
In her opinion, Luo Tian obviously didn't tell the truth.
Can the cultivation level of the body refining realm reach this level?
Who are you lying to?
Seeing this, Luo Tian also understood the other party's mood.
But he didn't bother to explain.
